proposals.before: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Yeci Getu, whom he had made King of Xi, came with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, pretending that they had come to attend court.
proposals.after: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Dielage plotted to become King of Xi and, together with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, arrived, falsely claiming they had come to attend court.
proposals.reason: Chinese 迭剌哥圖為奚王 means Dielage (迭剌哥) plotted (圖) to become King of Xi, not a personal name “Yeci Getu” who had already been made King of Xi.

proposals.before: On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, the younger brother Yeci Getu, who had been made King of Xi, arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they came to pay court.
proposals.after: On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, the younger brother Dielage plotted to become King of Xi, and with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen arrived, falsely claiming they came to pay court.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise misreads 圖為奚王 as “who had been made King of Xi” and splits 迭剌哥 into the invented “Yeci Getu.”

proposals.before: In the fourth summer month Zhu Yougui, Liang's Prince of Ying, murdered his father and seized the throne.
proposals.after: In the fourth summer month You, Liang's Prince of Ying, murdered his father and seized the throne.
proposals.reason: Chinese names him only as 郢王友; the idiomatic “Zhu Yougui” invents a surname and given-name syllable not in the unit.

proposals.before: On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, You Zhen, Prince of Jun of Liang, attacked and killed his elder brother You, and succeeded to the throne.
proposals.after: On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, Youzhen, Prince of Jun of Liang, attacked and killed his elder brother You, and succeeded to the throne.
proposals.reason: Literal splits the given name 友貞 into “You Zhen”; it is a single name Youzhen.

proposals.before: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige took Pingzhou and came back, only to rise again with Yeci, Yindishi, Anduan, and the rest.
proposals.after: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Dieci, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
proposals.reason: Earlier units render 迭剌 as Dieci; this unit’s “Yeci” is the same brother and should stay consistent.

proposals.before: Pursued to Chai River, they thereupon burned their carts, mounts, and tents and fled.
proposals.after: Pursued to Chai River, they thereupon burned their carts, wagons, and tents and fled.
proposals.reason: Checheng means wheeled vehicles or carriages, not mounts; idiomatic already has wagons.

proposals.before: His partisans Kuguzhi and Moduo all came with faces bound to beg forgiveness.
proposals.after: His partisans Kuguzhi and Moduo all came forward with their hands bound to beg forgiveness.
proposals.reason: Mianfu means binding the hands behind the back, not binding the face; idiomatic is correct.

proposals.before: In the eighth autumn month Li Cunxu sent Li Siyuan and others to relieve Youzhou; Helu and the others, finding their forces too few, withdrew.
proposals.after: In the eighth autumn month Li Cun sent Li Siyuan and others to relieve Youzhou; Helu and the others, finding their forces too few, withdrew.
proposals.reason: Chinese writes only 李存; idiomatic invents the expanded form Li Cunxu not present in the unit.

proposals.before: Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature weak and foolish and had been used by Cige, their crimes were all pardoned.
proposals.after: Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature mediocre and weak and had been used by Cige, their crimes were all pardoned.
proposals.reason: 庸弱 means mediocre and weak; literal's 'foolish' is unsupported.

proposals.before: On wuwu day Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dieci department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
proposals.after: On wuwu day Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
proposals.reason: Chinese 迭烈部 is Dielie (same 迭烈 as in Dielige); English Dieci misrenders 烈.

proposals.before: On wuwu day, Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dieci Department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
proposals.after: On wuwu day, Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie Department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
proposals.reason: Chinese 迭烈部 is Dielie; Dieci is a mistransliteration of 烈.

decisions.after: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and, together with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, arrived, falsely claiming they had come to attend court.
decisions.reason: 圖為奚王 describes Diela's design to become King of Xi. The proposal fixes the syntax, but the historically standard name is Diela, not Dielage.

decisions.after: On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, his younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they had come to pay court.
decisions.reason: The literal field also invents 'Yeci Getu' and misparses 圖為. Diela is the standard name of Abaoji's younger brother 迭剌.

sourceWitness.citation: Liao Shi, vols. 1 and 64; https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/遼史/卷1

decisions.reason: The received text identifies Zhu Yougui. Wikisource preserves the complete name 友珪, confirming that our Chinese unit lost 珪; the existing English correctly restores the historically identifiable subject.
友貞 is the single given name Youzhen; splitting it as You Zhen is incorrect.

decisions.after: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
decisions.reason: 迭剌 is the emperor's younger brother Yelü Diela. Both 'Yeci' and the proposal's 'Dieci' are nonstandard misreadings.

sourceWitness.citation: Liao Shi, vols. 1 and 64; https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/遼史/卷1
sourceWitness.excerpt: 復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反

decisions.reason: 車乘 means carts or carriages; 'mounts' is unsupported and duplicates the vehicle sense poorly.
面縛 is the submission posture of binding one's hands behind one's back, not binding one's face.
Wikisource preserves the complete name 李存勗. Our Chinese unit has lost 勗, but the existing English correctly identifies Li Cunxu; shortening it to Li Cun would introduce an error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 李存勗遣李嗣源等救幽州

decisions.reason: 庸弱 means mediocre and weak; it does not add the separate judgment 'foolish.'
The department is 迭烈, Dielie. 'Dieci' misreads the final character 烈.
The literal field must likewise render 迭烈部 as the Dielie Department.

claimRevisions.reason: The standard English form of 迭剌 is Diela.
Context and the biography in volume 64 identify the younger brother here as Yelü Diela; 哥 is not a separate syllable in his standard name.
